title: Rust: DAO retry backoff (4, 8, 16s exponential)
description: Implement DAO exponential retry backoff. AC: Retries at 4s, 8s, 16s intervals.
close_reason: Implemented exact 4/8/16-second DAO retry schedule with bounded state, explicit exhaustion, checked Duration deadlines, overflow-safe non-consumption, reset behavior, deterministic tests, and no_std public API; lichen-rpl tests/fmt/scoped clippy/no_std are green.
